rules.description: When related records come from the same database, combine them in the database query rather than matching, merging, or enriching them in application code.
exceptions: The data comes from different services or databases.
The join cannot reasonably be expressed by the database or ORM.

rules.description: For type declarations, every boolean property or field name must begin with Is or Should. Code units that are not type declarations pass this rule.
Comments should be helpful and concise without focusing too much on what the code is doing.
